context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct Mode B ad-hoc advisory lookup command format with the right subcommand, language, package name, and version — and then reports each advisory with all required fields.

checklist.name: Advisories subcommand
checklist.description: Uses the `advisories get` subcommand (not `check` or any other subcommand)

checklist.name: npx invocation
checklist.description: Invokes the CLI via `npx @meterian/cli advisories get ...` (not a bare `meterian` command)

checklist.name: Correct language
checklist.description: Passes `python` as the language argument (not `py`, `pip`, or `python3`)

checklist.name: Package name in command
checklist.description: Passes `urllib3` as the package name argument in the CLI command

checklist.name: Version in command
checklist.description: Passes `1.24.1` as the version argument in the CLI command

checklist.name: Severity reported
checklist.description: Report lists the severity level for each advisory found

checklist.name: ID reported
checklist.description: Report lists the advisory ID (CVE or similar) for each advisory found

checklist.name: Description reported
checklist.description: Report includes a description of each advisory found
